lib/action.title: Action
lib/action.description: The pending flag, the double-submit guard and the one agreed way to say an async handler failed.

lib/announce.title: Announce
lib/announce.description: Says something to a screen reader, and says it again when the words have not changed.

lib/debounce.title: Debounce
lib/debounce.description: Delays a call until the calls stop coming, with cancel, flush and a pending flag.

lib/fold.title: Fold
lib/fold.description: Folds text into the form searches compare against - lower case, no accents.

lib/focus.title: Focus
lib/focus.description: The focus-visible outline Coral draws on the controls it renders itself, in four placements.

lib/hidden-field.title: Hidden field
lib/hidden-field.description: The hidden input that lets a select, combobox or date picker take part in a plain form.

lib/intl.title: Intl
lib/intl.description: Collators and formatters built once per locale and options, instead of once per call.

lib/live-region.title: Live region
lib/live-region.description: The visually hidden region every component announces through, polite or assertive.

lib/number-field.title: Number field
lib/number-field.description: The stepping, committing and wheel handling a number input and a scrub input share.

lib/number.title: Number
lib/number.description: The clamping, rounding and parsing the number fields share, as plain functions.

lib/on-close.title: On close
lib/on-close.description: Runs a callback when something closes - however it closed, including by assignment.

lib/options.title: Options
lib/options.description: The Option<T> vocabulary the selectable components share, and the helpers that flatten and group it.

lib/trigger.title: Trigger
lib/trigger.description: The id and aria-* attributes a form hands a control, typed for the components whose trigger is a button.

lib/table.title: Table
lib/table.description: Sorting, filtering, paging and selection for a table of rows, as plain functions.

kit/action-button.title: Action button
kit/action-button.description: A button that waits on its own request, blocks the second click, and keeps focus.

kit/activity-calendar.title: Activity calendar
kit/activity-calendar.description: A year of daily counts as a grid of squares - the GitHub contribution graph, with the timezone and the scale done right.

kit/avatar.title: Avatar
kit/avatar.description: A person's image with an initials fallback, wired in one line.

kit/avatar-stack.title: Avatar stack
kit/avatar-stack.description: Overlapping avatars with a count for the rest - and a list a screen reader can read.

kit/combobox.title: Combobox
kit/combobox.description: A select with a search box, filtering the way accented text is actually typed.

kit/command-palette.title: Command palette
kit/command-palette.description: ⌘K over your own actions - with recents, per-action shortcuts, and a run that can fail.

kit/confirm-dialog.title: Confirm dialog
kit/confirm-dialog.description: Are you sure? - with the request it guards, and what happens when that request fails.

kit/copy-button.title: Copy button
kit/copy-button.description: Copies text to the clipboard, says so out loud, and says so when it could not.

kit/data-table.title: Data table
kit/data-table.description: Rows with sortable headers, selection that survives a sort, and its own loading and empty states.

kit/date-picker.title: Date picker
kit/date-picker.description: A popover, a calendar and a formatted trigger. One day or two, with shortcuts.

kit/file-input.title: File input
kit/file-input.description: Pick files by click or drop, validate them, show what was picked. An input, not an uploader.

kit/follow-scroll.title: Follow scroll
kit/follow-scroll.description: A scroller that stays at the end while new content arrives - and stops the moment the reader scrolls away.

kit/inline-edit.title: Inline edit
kit/inline-edit.description: Text that turns into a field in place - rename a project, a column, a file.

kit/number-input.title: Number input
kit/number-input.description: A number field with steppers, bounds that hold, and arithmetic that stays exact.

kit/page-state.title: Page state
kit/page-state.description: The states a screen goes through - waiting, failed, empty, content - and a wait that does not flash.

kit/password-input.title: Password input
kit/password-input.description: A password field with a visibility toggle that does not break password managers.

kit/rating-group.title: Rating group
kit/rating-group.description: Stars you can pick and stars you can only read. Native radios underneath, so the keyboard, the form and the screen reader come for free.

kit/relative-time.title: Relative time
kit/relative-time.description: Timestamps like 5 minutes ago that stay true, in the reader's language, without a timer per second.

kit/reorder-list.title: Reorder list
kit/reorder-list.description: Drag to reorder with a mouse, a finger or the keyboard - and persist once per drop.

kit/responsive-dialog.title: Responsive dialog
kit/responsive-dialog.description: A dialog on wide screens and a drawer on narrow ones, written once.

kit/scrub-input.title: Scrub input
kit/scrub-input.description: A number field whose label is a drag handle - drag it, type it, or step it with the arrow keys.

kit/search-input.title: Search input
kit/search-input.description: A search field that debounces, deduplicates, clears with Escape, and leaves dialogs open.

kit/select.title: Select
kit/select.description: A short list of known options, with the trigger label, the value mapping and the change signal already wired.

kit/shortcut.title: Shortcut
kit/shortcut.description: Draws a keyboard shortcut the way the reader's platform prints it, and binds it.

kit/show-more.title: Show more
kit/show-more.description: Clamps long content to a few lines, and only offers to expand what actually overflows.

kit/stepper.title: Stepper
kit/stepper.description: Multi-step flows with validation that waits, steps that cannot be skipped, and focus that follows.

kit/tags-input.title: Tags input
kit/tags-input.description: A field that turns typed and pasted text into tags, with one rule for both.

kit/textarea.title: Textarea
kit/textarea.description: A textarea that grows with its text, up to a line count you set, with a counter that agrees with the limit.

kit/toc.title: Table of contents
kit/toc.description: A table of contents that highlights the section being read, including the last one.

kit/tree-view.title: Tree view
kit/tree-view.description: A hierarchy the keyboard can walk - the WAI-ARIA tree pattern, from a plain array.

blocks/table-panel.title: Table panel
blocks/table-panel.description: A table with the screen around it - search, paging, bulk actions, and two different empty states.
